name: Tesla Optimus
description: Tesla's general-purpose bipedal humanoid, developed in-house for factory work and eventual home/consumer use. Not yet for sale — still in limited internal deployment at Tesla facilities.

specs.label: Weight
specs.note: ~57 kg, Gen 2 baseline; further reduced on later builds

specs.label: Hand DOF
specs.note: Gen 3 hand, up from 11 on Gen 2

specs.label: Current Build
specs.note: V3 reveal repeatedly delayed as of Sept 2026

pricing.summary: No confirmed retail price. Elon Musk has floated a rough estimate around $20,000–$30,000 for a future consumer version, but Tesla has not published official pricing. Musk has said Optimus could go on sale to outside buyers in the second half of 2027 — commercial availability has not begun.

firmwareCommunity.note: Tesla has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API for Optimus. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.

sourcing: Specs reflect the last officially confirmed generation (Optimus Gen 2 / v2.3) per Tesla's own announcements and reporting from Electrek and The Robot Report; Gen 3 ("V3") has been previewed but not fully detailed as of September 2026, per Electrek and Wikipedia's sourced summary. robotindex does not sell this product — Optimus is not currently available for purchase.
